interpretation: For this single normalized (D^2 Sigma)^2 rescue, even percent-level preservation of the historical production RTK gradient kernel forces eta4 to be of order 1e-11 or smaller. This is a quantitative tuning signal, not a no-go: multi-operator cancellations, symmetry relations, or a different completion can change the conclusion.
local_rest_rescue_dispersion: omega^2=eta4 k^4/(mu_K^2+k^2) for the isolated candidate operator with eta4>0
next_gate: compare the required eta4 window with finite-amplitude local-rest canonical dynamics and with radiative generation estimates; then test a minimal multi-operator higher-spatial basis if a single eta4 term is too tuned
non_claims: does not prove this is the unique higher-spatial completion
does not include higher-spatial metric/U1 operators or cancellations among several operators
does not establish technical naturalness of a tiny eta4
does not compute a scattering cutoff
does not replace a full likelihood replay with eta4 nonzero
does not use a new best-fit RTK point; it is tied to the historical certified reference until that reference is superseded

reference.role: historical independently replay-certified RTK local reference; refresh if a new RTK production reference supersedes it
